$comment: Per-shot visual review (typographic hierarchy + composition, scored 1-10 from contact sheets) and declared INTENT targets used by score_frames.py. density = fraction of the high-octane density target this shot is designed to hit; motion = motion energy (mean |dY| per frame at 240x135) that earns full motion marks. Intent changes the target a frame is scored against; it never hides a frame.

S1.notes: Brief: pitch-black screen + a single razor line. Code slate legible at 25u; act slate deliberately faint.

S2.notes: Phrase in the clean upper third, 'hand-drawn' pen-stroked by the 7cqw cursor; 3D-tracked labels clamped to safe area.

S3.notes: 'glass' hero stands where the pane shattered; 'and time.' lower-right lands on the clock accent.

S4.notes: Strong title hierarchy (Claude / Opus / 5.5); origami panels secondary; code line tertiary.

S5.notes: 'geometry of thought' woven between ribbon depth layers; Astra title crystallizes with dark halo for legibility.

S6.notes: Particles on black are sparse by nature; 'solar logic.' hero burns in on the machine phase.

S7.notes: 'Two' / 'titans.' collide at the seam — the clearest type beat in the film.

S8.notes: Phrase at lower centre is readable; code tokens are texture, not copy.

S9.notes: 3D camera moves produce smaller pixel deltas than 2D motion graphics; 'never witnessed.' / 'Look closer.' / 'The canvas is dead.'

S10.notes: Clean centred isometric lockup; names flank the emblem; 'Long live the code.' serif + mono.

S11.notes: Snap-cut to black: only the dual-core signature remains (brief). Scored against that intent.
